dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: What a spacious kitchen! With all this equipment, we could provide enough marching rations for an entire company!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Being here reminds me of the gatherings I had with my teammates.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Although I can't drink with everyone, I'm happy just to be part of the conversation.
